title: Actionified Vanilla
description: A long fought battle of coming as close to Actions & Stuff as possible on java with mods.
body:
# **Actionified Vanilla** 

This modpack was born of my personal desire to not spend 10 dollars on Actions & Stuff for bedrock. With **carefully picked mods** that allow you to play on the **latest version** as of writing this **26.1.2!**

![The background of the banner is a screenshot of a minecraft sunset over a dark roofed forest with the title of the modpack "Actionified Vanilla" in the foreground in the classic minecraft update title style with big bold stylized letters layered one over another](https://i.imgur.com/sDMpIoW.png)

## **Features**
Built on the shoulders of giants like **Fresh Animations** and **Punchy!** This modpack is built with aesthetics and a cozy/cartoony atmosphere in mind! To achieve this, it **includes**:

### **Performance**🚀
- All your favorite **optimisations mods** like Sodium, Entity Culling and BadOptimizations.

### **Visuals**✨
- **Enhanced shader free visuals** featuring new particle effects, 3D items, and a customized presets for coloured skies, fog and haze per biome.

### **Animations**🪄
- **Animations** for mobs and the player provided by **Fresh Animations** and **Extensions** along with **Punchy!** for the first person animations.

### **Ambience**🦜
- **Overhauled atmosphere and ambience** featuring ambient biome sounds, birds painting the skies and moths hovering about lanterns provided by **Atmosfera** and **Cosy Critters**.

### **UX**🖥️
- **A smooth and polished UI experience** with smooth scrolling, GUI animations and immersive hotbar animations.

### **ENTIRELY CLIENT-SIDE**🎉
This modpack does it all without altering the core gameplay at all! Allowing you to **play on servers** or **with friends** seamlessly without requiring you to disable any of the mods.

___Tiny disclaimer and tutorial, the punchy config acts weird for whatever reason so if you encounter any items that look weird in the first person hand just press F8 -> Hand editor -> Select 'Actionifed' -> Load profile, and everything should be good :3___
